title: Local Kepler fits do not show a fixed 3-to-2 phase relation for two known KIC 4064484 signals
abstract: We test a fixed relative phase for the known signals at f2 and 1.5 f2 in KIC 4064484. Kepler release 25 data give phase concentrations of 0.082 in aperture flux and 0.113 in corrected flux for 129 eight-day segments. All 12 fits with three segment lengths and two primary harmonic counts give values below 0.216. Tests with added signals recover a fixed local relation under a residual block model. The result limits a simple fixed-shape waveform with a changing common phase. It does not reject general period doubling or non-radial pulsation models. The signal and its variation were known. We report no new planet or stellar mode. The two flux products share exposures. Independent telescope and pixel-level confirmation are absent. Code, selected samples, hashes, fit tables, recovery tests and offline instructions are included.

display.caption: Local phases, child amplitudes, concentration for three windows, and recovery tests for a fixed phase relation. Vertical lines in panel D mark observed concentration. The curves show simulations with the same fitted amplitudes and resampled residual noise. Both flux products share exposures.
